component.name: VLC Neon
component.summary: VLC media player with seek previews, Picture-in-Picture and practical playback controls

description.p: VLC Neon is an unofficial build of the VLC 4 media player with a neon identity and extra everyday controls: thumbnail previews on the seek bar, a separate Picture-in-Picture window, speed presets, repeat counts, volume boost, resume prompts and per-file settings.
Based on VLC media player by VideoLAN. Not an official VideoLAN product.
